author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

Updates the Phase-2 (D128) GPU workflows in `cmssw-pr-test-config` for the new `CMSSW_20_1_X` release cycle, and switches PR GPU tests back to pileup workflows now that 20_X_Y MinBias files are available:

- **`CMSSW_20_1_X` and later** (`CMSSW_VER >= 2001`), new clause:
  - `PR_TEST_MATRIX_EXTRAS` stays `1306.0,101.0,9.0`.
  - `PR_TEST_MATRIX_EXTRAS_GPU` uses the `38634.*` pileup workflows (`.402`, `.403`, `.404`, `.712`, `.713`, `.7503`, `.751`).
  - Adds `38634.7511` (`HLT75e33TimingEgammaSeedingPortable`) to the GPU PR tests.
- **`CMSSW_20_0_X`** (`CMSSW_VER >= 2000`): `PR_TEST_MATRIX_EXTRAS_GPU` switches from the no-pileup `38434.*` workflows to the pileup `38464.*` workflows, with the same set of suffixes.
- Removes the now-obsolete "use no-pileup workflow until first 20_X_Y MinBias files become available" comment.

Older release cycles are unchanged.
title: Update Phase-2 GPU PR test workflows for 20_0_X and 20_1_X
